Personal Homelab.desc: Blog page outlining my personal homelab setup.

Amethyst Administrator.desc: Purple team security and network management tool written in Python that is designed to map out and allow pre-configured easy access to devices over large networks.

gl0bSECURE OBD-II Tool.desc: Custom-built Python tool designed to streamline development for other automotive diagnostic tools. Utilizes the CAN protocol that is widely used in automobiles.

CrossJoin (As Maintainer).desc: Discord bot designed to monitor and post information from the Alberta Electric System Operator (AESO) and Alberta 511.

AOSCS.desc:
Advanced Open-Source Certification System.

 An successor to both TIGRS and OGRS independent media rating systems, while also being compatible with FreeDesktop AppStream. AOSCS is the 'be-all-end-all' solution to independent rating and certification services.

EmbedTube.desc: Browser extension designed to replace the built-in YouTube video player with embedded versions.

NoQuoraLogin.desc: UserScript that allows users visiting Quora to circumvent requests to login and use features that would normally require a account.

GABS.desc:
gl0bSECURE Automated Backup System

 Linux script designed to automatically replicate contents from one drive to another. Its intended use is to have data replication without the use of RAID.

Lost Media Wiki Retheme.desc: UserScript that adaptively changes how pages look on the Lost Media Wiki based on what categories they have been assigned. This is achieved by injecting CSS pages from an external source.

Wake on LAN Website.desc: Website built in PHP designed to send Wake on LAN magic packets to hosts on an internal network by MAC address.

Youtube Download-and-Delete.desc: Website built with PHP designed to provide a simple-to-use frontend for YT-DLP. Its built for low-capacity systems and designed for temporary viewing and downloading of media.

Filespeed.desc: Created for a college midterm, FileSpeed is a simple file sharing website that uses randomly generated filenames for shareable links. The website is built with PHP and features a SHA1 upload blacklist and extensive logging.

Cisco4FPBX.desc: Script designed to simplify TFTP configuration for Cisco phones using FreePBX.

LiteNVR.desc: Minimal self-healing NVR system engineered to capture raw RTSP camera streams via FFmpeg and write them directly to a remote network-attached storage (NAS) share.

Slack Door Access Notify.desc: Lightweight PHP webpage designed to post users IP address and user agent to a Slack webhook. Intended to notify someone inside the room that someone else is at the door.

JS DVD Menu Simulator.desc: Client-side web framework designed to simulate menu systems from DVD's.

Test Drive Pong for Windows.desc: Created for an assignment and released with permission from the instructor, this Windows form project is a remake of the loading screen from the racing video-game Test Drive on the PlayStation 2.

DiskSmasher.desc: Open-source version of a proprietary disk scanning script built in PowerShell. It has also been written from scratch and does not modify settings (only scans).

BrowserNeedle.desc: PowerShell script designed to analyze web browsers on a Windows system. It can extract browser history, installed extensions, and other relevant data from popular browsers like Microsoft Edge, Google Chrome, and Mozilla Firefox. Used for both blue-team and red-team purposes.

AuditDeepscan.desc: PowerShell script designed to process audit log entries from a Microsoft Purview Audit Export CSV file, extracts IP addresses, and queries an external API to retrieve detailed information about those IPs. It enriches the audit log entries with this information and provides options to filter based on multiple criteria such as IP type, UserID, and Operation type.
